recipes.oracle_text: Return target card from your graveyard to your hand. Exile Treasured Find.

recipe_coverage: Oracle-reviewed single-card recovery: eligible alternatives and full-zone indices, type/color/value restrictions, graveyard ownership, exact/insufficient mana, empty zone, ordered unaffected zones, target departure and index shift through a real Reclaim response, populated-zone snapshot replay. Reanimation also checks entry characteristics and subsequent death ownership; subtype bonuses are explicit. Multi-target recovery, graveyard shroud, replacement effects, and exceptional card types remain separate. Existing noncreature selection defects are represented by isolated eligible_type legality assertions; complex recovery scenarios currently use legal creature choices. Restore the noncreature type resolution variants when those defects are fixed.
